answer: Cosignatures are collected in river, verified in bridge, and anchor names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 32 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and therefore paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 355 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
